meta.source: GNU Emacs Modus themes (modus-operandi, modus-vivendi), palettes read from modus-themes.el, 2026-10-03. Modus is GPL-3.0-or-later; its colour values are reproduced here as data.
meta.layers: Base tokens keep the Modus palette names (bg-main, fg-dim, blue ...). Semantic tokens are aliases of base tokens and are what components use.

tokens.name: bg-dim
tokens.usage: Modus bg-dim. Panels, sidebars, code blocks.

tokens.name: bg-active
tokens.usage: Modus bg-active. The active window's mode line; pressed controls.

tokens.name: bg-inactive
tokens.usage: Modus bg-inactive. Inactive mode lines; disabled controls.

tokens.name: bg-hl-line
tokens.usage: Modus bg-hl-line. Current line, hovered row.

tokens.name: fg-dim
tokens.usage: Modus fg-dim. Secondary text; measures 7:1 on bg-main in both themes.

tokens.name: fg-alt
tokens.usage: Modus fg-alt. An alternative text colour for emphasis without weight.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Modus border. Decorative dividers only: 2.65:1 on white, below the 3:1 UI floor, so never the outline of a control.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Semantic: the page background. Components use this, not bg-main.

tokens.name: canvas-dim
tokens.usage: Semantic: panel, sidebar, code block background.

tokens.name: canvas-line
tokens.usage: Semantic: current line, hovered row, open fold's headline.

tokens.name: canvas-active
tokens.usage: Semantic: the active mode line / status bar; pressed buttons.

tokens.name: canvas-inactive
tokens.usage: Semantic: inactive status bar; disabled controls.

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Semantic: secondary text, timestamps, property values.

tokens.name: text-alt
tokens.usage: Semantic: emphasis without bold; the mode line's buffer name.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Semantic: links and the primary action.

tokens.name: signal-warning
tokens.usage: Semantic: warnings. Modus yellow is a dark ochre in operandi; it is text, never a fill.

tokens.name: border-divider
tokens.usage: Semantic: hairlines between regions. Decorative: carries no meaning on its own.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Semantic: the outline of inputs, buttons, checkboxes. 7:1, so a control is findable without colour vision.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Semantic: 2px ring, 2px offset, on every focusable thing.

styles.name: headline-1
styles.usage: org level-1 headline; HTML h2 after export

styles.name: code
styles.usage: src blocks, tables, timestamps, TODO keywords, tags, property drawers, key bindings

styles.name: code-small
styles.usage: the mode line / status bar, line numbers

spacing.note: Two rhythms. Prose uses a 4px scale. Anything fixed-pitch is laid out in character cells (1ch wide, 1lh tall) so it lines up the way a buffer does.

tokens.name: cell-w
tokens.usage: one character column in a fixed-pitch region

tokens.name: cell-h
tokens.usage: one line in a fixed-pitch region

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything by default. Buffers have corners.
